title: Trisomy 21 Model Atlas: Analysis Code
description: R-based statistical analysis and visualization code for the Trisomy 21 Model Atlas, an openly accessible resource of transcriptomic and histopathological data from mouse and human iPSC-derived models of Down syndrome. Each analysis workflow is a self-contained R Project with an renv lockfile. Atlas data can be explored at https://experimentalmodels.includedcc.org/trisomy-21-model-atlas.html. See the repository README for the release table and data sources.
